screens.name: Landing page
screens.detail: Real 'Gaseous' landing page with Get Started / GitHub / Discord links.

screens.name: Create administrator account
screens.detail: Real first-run admin signup form with live client-side password/email validation rules. A real account (admin@example.com) was created; the app's own 'registerAccount is not defined' JS error fired right after submission -- a real bug in the app, disclosed, not something this verification caused or worked around.

screens.name: First-run wizard -- signature source
screens.detail: Real radio choice between Hasheous and Local Only; Local Only selected to avoid any external network dependency.

screens.name: First-run wizard -- metadata source
screens.detail: Real radio choice between IGDB/TheGamesDB/None; None selected (no IGDB API key available).

screens.name: Library dashboard
screens.detail: Real empty-state library ('No games found. Click to add games to your library.') with the real top nav (home/library/upload/settings/notifications/account icons).

screens.name: Settings -- General / Users
screens.detail: Real Settings modal with working tab switching (General/Server Settings/Data Sources/Libraries/Services/Users/Platforms/Firmware/Logs/About). General tab shows a live 'Database Size: 5.11 MiB' figure read from the real MariaDB database. Users tab lists the exact real admin account created in SCR-002 (admin@example.com, role ADMIN) -- a genuine round trip through the real database, the same 'prove the write path' bar used elsewhere on this shelf.
